messages.author: 4fb76301a14d098f
messages.subject: Align colorspace reads using Subjunc
parts:
Hello All,

I have two questions about using Subjunc to align color space reads. I aligned SOLid reads downloaded from SRA with the following command,

subjunc -i ../subread.colorspace.index -T16 -H -u -M 2 \
-r input.sra_F3.csfasta -o output.subjunc --BAMoutput

The alignment was smooth. When I loaded the indexed BAM file to JBrowse, however, I noticed that most of the reads were aligned to the opposite strand. Any thoughts as to the reason? Is there any particular option I should've applied for colorspace reads? 

My second question is about strand specificity. Is is possible to enforce specific strand? These reads are strand-specific RNA-seq libraries so I was looking for this option.

Thank you for your input.

Chia-Yi

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: Align colorspace reads using Subjunc
parts:
Hi Chia-Yi,

You need to check the protocol used for your strand-specific sequencing. It seems the anti-sense strand was sequenced, instead of sense strand, in your experiment. I have seen this many times.

Cheers,
Wei

messages.author: 4fb76301a14d098f
messages.subject: Re: Align colorspace reads using Subjunc
parts:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for the tip. I have contacted the author who generated the libraries. As you pointed out, this protocol was supposed to sequence AS instead of sense strand. Thank you.

Chia-Yi
